name: saos
description: Soto Accounting Operating System — self-hosted business OS for Soto Accounting LLC + Hilo NFP

scripts.test: npm run check:prices && npm run check:sops && npm run check:env-merge && npm run check:role-tasks && npm run check:css-classes && npm run check:form-conditionals && npm run check:sop-steps && npm run check:no-sos-scraping && npm run check:client-sends && npm run check:flash-once && npm run check:date-rendering && npm run check:no-native-dialogs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.staging:up: docker compose -p saos-staging -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml up -d
scripts.staging:down: docker compose -p saos-staging -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml down
